method.comparison_scale: Current 618x824; reference 1236x1648 at owner-declared physical scale 2. Geometry observations are visual approximations.

observations: The upper-right popup sits below the overflow dots. Its four-row rectangle, inset, border and spacing visibly follow the reference after accounting for the declared 2x reference scale; the approximate native extent is x340-603, y76-300.

The four menu labels are legible and contained. The last row uses pale text plus a readable right-aligned unavailable label. The popup covers part of the description in the same intended region as the reference.

Serif book and contents headings, heavier chapter titles, and smaller gray author, description, count and date glyphs retain visible hierarchy. Back/overflow, resume arrow, bookmark flag, tracking arrow, sort/download marks and next chevron remain recognizable inside their control bounds.

The continue control visibly retains chapter 34 and page 12/40. Six chapter rows, dates and the 1/8 folio remain readable with the menu open; no requested-design or ordinary-reading blocker is visible.
capability_checks: Static modal items expose reload, migrate and category, with screensaver disabled. The visible unavailable row truthfully reflects that state; the enabled sample screensaver is not used to claim hardware support.
Shorter menu wording preserves the displayed context-specific action roles. No individual choice effect or success result is claimed from this capture.
cases.static_support: The frozen recipe contains only detail/more at 650 ms; state and sidecars identify detail, choices, detail-more, pw5, desktop, 618x824 and no active reader.
cases.reader_scope: This is an open detail menu, not a closed-reader capture. The saved resume entry is visible; resume execution and pure-reader behavior are outside this pair.

observations: The bottom sheet has a strong top rule, a serif Tracking heading and a fully visible black Done button. Its smaller unconfigured content starts lower than the sample linked-service sheet; both layouts retain the bottom-sheet hierarchy.

AniList and MyAnimeList each show a dashed card, a strong service-name glyph, a smaller gray unconfigured state and a black Configure control. Card outlines, text, button labels and bottom clearance are visible without clipping; the reference's dashed unlinked treatment remains applicable and is preserved.

The linked AniList status, progress and rating form is omitted for the actual unconfigured state. Both service entries show configuration availability without any linked, authorization or synchronization success claim.

Book/title/body hierarchy, back/overflow, resume arrow, bookmark flag, tracking arrow and sort/download glyphs remain recognizable. The chapter-34/page-12/40 resume entry and two complete visible chapter rows remain readable above the sheet.
capability_checks: The frozen capability declaration states tracking_authorization_implemented=false and server_configuration_implemented=true. Two unconfigured cards and configuration entry points are consistent with that bound.

Unconfigured data changes do not waive applicable glyph hierarchy, card outline or control extent checks; those are directly observed above. The Done label closes the visible panel role and is not interpreted as authorization success.
cases.static_support: The frozen recipe contains only detail/track at 650 ms; state and sidecars identify detail, choices, tracking, pw5, desktop, 618x824 and no active reader. Configuration navigation and authorization are not executed by the supplied recipe.
cases.reader_scope: This is an open tracking sheet, not a closed-reader capture. The saved resume entry is visible; no executed resume, pure-reader or lifecycle-resume credit is assigned.

bounded_result: No new requested-design, visible pure-reader/resume or ordinary-use blocker is evidenced by the two assigned open-detail pairs. This completes only this bounded visual review.
limitations: Exact typeface and 500/700 font weights were not measured; this is a precision limitation, not unresolved visible glyph review.
Only the supplied detail-opening recipes support these captures. Individual menu effects, configuration navigation, authorization and actual resume were not observed.
Open detail panels cannot establish closed-reader purity, hidden hit regions, physical input, hardware behavior, lifecycle resume, e-ink effects, live-reader lease or performance.
Global producer capture and final manifest/inventory/reconciliation remain pending; no full-round closure is claimed.
